The Space:

NEWLY RENOVATED 2023

An unforgettable 4-bedroom + 2 bunk room luxury vacation home located directly on the field at the famed Camp WaterColor. Tons of new updates for 2023. Take full advantage of the home's many exterior porches that provide a great vantage point to watch the kids play on the field or fish in the Camp Pond! You also will enjoy the close proximity to the pool and playground. With 3,200 square feet of indoor living space and 1,200 square feet of outdoor living space, there is plenty of room for multiple families to spread out. Comfort and luxury are at the heart of 349 Spartina Circle. Check availability and book with 30A Vacay today!



The home features sleeping arrangements for 15 with great hideaways for some quiet time. If you must do some work while visiting the beach, 349 Spartina has you covered. The home has an office with built-in desk. But of course, don't get too comfortable behind the computer with everything that the area has to offer out the front door!



Watercolor Beach is located in the heart of 30A. Within walking, biking distance to the shops and dining Seaside and Watercolor Beach have to offer. reviews.text:
This was a great house for our group of 12. The location worked well for us to have the field right outside our back door. Our group spent time there and at the Camp Watercolor pools which were close. The beach and Beach Club required a long walk or short bike ride. The kids seemed to enjoy the bike ride, so this wasn't an issue for us. The property manager was easily reached via text or phone call during regular office hours. A few minor maintenance issues during the stay but nothing that needed immediate attention. 
Overall, a very enjoyable stay. Great community with several options for different age groups. We did lose a couple of wristbands and only one was replaced per the HOA rules. So, great care should be taken to keep track of the wristbands as that is how you access the pools and beach.

reviews.text:
House is great. Location is awesome with huge green space for kids to play & pool nearby. 

Unfortunately our reservation was 3/14-21. Watercolor started closing mid week. Pools, amenities, and beach access. Sent a couple messages to property manager asking if we could have a credit towards future rental. 

Got about a 12 word response.. Disappointing to say the best. We are all dealing with unforeseen coronavirus issues. I don’t think it would have been unreasonable to offer a credit/discount for future rental. 

My family has been to 30A 5 times in the past few years. Moving forward we will be using a different rental company.
